A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work with readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A.1–A.15. Comparison of all 15 pages establishes that differences are confined to the arXiv version/date stamp and one appendix-heading typo.

before.justification: v1 reports original surrogate-model experiments, vision-language benchmark results, training-time measurements, and ablations in Sections 1–2 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experiments and outcomes, including benchmark comparisons in Tables 1–8, training times in Table 9, and supplementary results in the appendices.

M1.justification: Surrogate construction, translator training, vision-encoder grafting, and decoder fine-tuning are identical. The dynamic loss weighting described in Appendix A.11 is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same LLaVA-1.5-665K and GenQA training data, vision-language and text benchmark suites in Appendix A.10, and supplementary test scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout, including full-size encoder/decoder baselines, LoRA in Appendix A.2 and Figure 2, and the distilled-model surrogate in Appendix A.12 and Figure A.5.

E3.justification: Training stages, model configurations, preprocessing, evaluation prompts, metrics, and sample sizes are unchanged. Tables A.4 and A.5 retain identical training and few-shot evaluation settings.

E4.justification: The same layer-preservation controls, language-degradation analysis, teacher-forcing check, generalizability experiments, and smaller/distilled-surrogate studies appear in both versions. No ablations, robustness analyses, or qualitative cases are added or removed.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical. Both versions present the same point estimates and sample-trajectory plots without introducing repeated-training-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted trends, and qualitative responses are unchanged, including appendix results. For example, Table 9 reports the same total training times: 34.79 hours for the baseline and 19.17 hours for the proposed approach.

T1.justification: The prediction-trajectory definitions and Equations (1)–(4) are identical, as is the dynamic loss-weight formula in Appendix A.11. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about zero-shot encoder grafting, preserving early-phase layers, and approximately 45% lower training cost with Llama-70B.

C2.justification: Interpretations of encoder transferability and language preservation are unchanged. Both versions retain the large-surrogate limitation in Section 4 and the small-model applicability and performance-degradation discussion in Appendix A.11.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hardware and timing disclosures, training recipes, hyperparameters, evaluation-tool information, and the displayed code-repository link are identical, including Appendices A.8–A.10.

R1.justification: Section 3 and all 53 references are unchanged. Positioning relative to interpretability, pruning, steering, LoRA, and progressive model scaling remains identical.

P1.justification: Appendix A.1 corrects 'Extra Columns for Main Tabel 8.' to 'Extra Columns for Main Table 8.' The arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 28 May 2025 to v2 dated 2 August 2025; the remaining language and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: All figures, tables, captions, axes, legends, placements, and substantive page layouts are unchanged. The heading correction causes no reflow, and rendered-page differences are confined to that correction and the marginal arXiv stamp.

improvement.justification: v2 only corrects a spelling error in Appendix A.1 and updates the arXiv stamp. These cosmetic edits leave the scientific content, evidence, reproducibility information, and substantive presentation unchanged, yielding no meaningful overall quality difference.
